purpose: Niche-first search. When a query matches a niche, search these sites first (site: through the configured search providers) and fall back to the regular planned search only when they return nothing or too few good results.
criteria: Ranked on: the size and depth of the site's existing catalogue for the niche; accuracy (editorial review, primary or official source, citations); reliability (long-lived, stable, well maintained); relevance to the niche's typical queries.
evidence: Initial ranks are a judgement from each site's known standing, not measurements. Every site and channel was checked to be live on the created date. Re-rank from the engine's own per-site relevance data once niche-first search runs.
format: Order within each list is the rank. An entry is either a site (a domain, optionally with a path) or a youtube channel handle. An empty list means general search serves that tab better than any niche-specific source. 'covers' describes the niche for matching queries to it; 'parent' marks a sub-niche; 'region' marks a source specific to one country.
